notes.title: Update Notes for v1.5.5
notes.content:
Tsundere Idol is now playable in Chinese (Traditional) and Chinese (Simplified) languages.

This version includes major updates to the user interface. Additional features including the Sprite Viewer with custom text box, audio player and more. Create your own moments with Rui.

notes.title: We're live!
notes.content:
[h1]We made it! [i]Tsundere Idol[/i] is officially live! I hope everyone is enjoying spending some quality time with Rui-Chan![/h1]

Similar to [i]Wild Romance: Mofu Mofu Edition[/i] the Trading Cards are coming but we have to reach that magical 'activity level' so if you haven't already, go tell your friends, leave us a review, like , share, subscribe, or whatever else Steam allows you to do.

I've also seen some people popping up telling me there is a problem installing the game and if you are having this issue I believe the problem is antiviruses are deleting the .exe file when it installs. We had this problem when [i]Wild Romance[/i] launched and it eventually stops happening when enough people download the game and antiviruses white list the application. We've taken steps to try to speed up this white listing process so hopefully it will be resolved soon, but if you are currently having this issue try disabling your antivirus when you first download and run the game and it should work just fine!
